title: Sparse Autoencoders Reveal Interpretable Structure in Small Gene Language Models
authors: Haoxiang Guan; Jiyan He; Jie Zhang
one_liner_zh: 该文用稀疏自编码器解析小型基因语言模型的内部表征，发现其编码转录因子结合基序等基因组特征，虽涉及TF-DNA相关基序但未聚焦结合互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have recently emerged as a powerful tool for interpreting the internal representations of large language models (LLMs), revealing latent latent features with semantical meaning. This interpretability has also proven valuable in biological domains: applying SAEs to protein language models uncovered meaningful features related to protein structure and function. More recently, SAEs have been used to analyze genomics-focused models such as Evo 2, identifying interpretable features in gene sequences. However, it remains unclear whether SAEs can extract meaningful representations from small gene language models, which have fewer parameters and potentially less expressive capacity. To address it, we propose applying SAEs to the activations of a small gene language model. We demonstrate that even small-scale models encode biologically relevant genomic features, such as transcription factor binding motifs, that SAEs can effectively uncover. Our findings suggest that compact gene language models are capable of learning structured genomic representations, and that SAEs offer a scalable approach for interpreting gene models across various model sizes.
abstract_zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）近来已成为解释大型语言模型（LLMs）内部表示的有力工具，揭示了具有语义意义的潜在特征。这种可解释性在生物学领域也显示出价值：将SAEs应用于蛋白质语言模型，发现了与蛋白质结构和功能相关的有意义特征。最近，SAEs被用于分析基因组学聚焦模型，如Evo 2，识别基因序列中的可解释特征。然而，尚不清楚SAEs能否从小型基因语言模型中提取有意义的表示，这些模型参数较少，可能表达能力有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出将SAEs应用于小型基因语言模型的激活。我们证明，即使是小规模模型也能编码生物学相关的基因组特征，如转录因子结合基序，而SAEs能有效揭示这些特征。我们的发现表明，紧凑型基因语言模型能够学习结构化的基因组表示，且SAEs为跨不同模型规模解释基因模型提供了一种可扩展的方法。
